2026‑09‑09T12:08:00‑04:00.name: IT'S NOT MY BIRTHDAY!
2026‑09‑09T12:08:00‑04:00.context: Eric's friends have an inside joke since last year where they started saying 'happy birthday', because someone told one of the teachers and they proceeded to say 'Happy birthday, Eric!' over the loudspeaker.
2026‑09‑09T12:08:00‑04:00.description: The team now has a running joke that Eric's birthday is year-round, and Eric embraces it, though he used to hate being told 'happy birthday' every single day.

wallet-and-keys.name: HEY! THAT'S MY WALLET AND KEYS!
wallet-and-keys.context: Mason steals Eric's keys as a joke while they are running out on the track at school, during the time the year is almost about to end and they are in the final days.
wallet-and-keys.description: Considered to be where it all started, this quote is the legendary phrase being passed around by the Eric Quote maintainers. This is among the first, and best, quotes from Eric.
